# Documentation Handbook

This Handbook supplies required understanding and does not own the user's task
procedure or completion. Apply its packaged guidance as supplemental to active
project instructions, requirements, Skills, and domain decisions.

## Select required reading

This Handbook has no common foundation. At the start of the work, evaluate every
package condition below from the current artifact, purpose, audience, and task
stage. Read every matching package before the decisions it informs; do not
choose only the nearest match. A focused request to learn or explain any
package's subject, including route review or current renderer behavior, selects
that package directly without forcing an unrelated package.

Reuse a reading unit that is already loaded, current, and available. Re-evaluate
all packages when the artifact, purpose, audience, software state, or task stage
changes. Reread a unit when it changed or its necessary basis can no longer be
established.

## Conditional required-reading packages

### Maintained document quality

When writing, maintaining, reviewing, correcting, or learning how to maintain
durable factual or software documentation, read
[Maintained document quality](../../knowledge/documentation/maintained-document-quality.md)
in full.

### Route review

When reviewing how documentation or Knowledge reaches an installed reader,
read the complete
[route-assessment section](../../knowledge/documentation/route-review.md#complete-route-assessment).

### Current renderer behavior

When the document's advice depends on the currently supported Acme renderer
format, read [Current Acme renderer behavior](../../knowledge/documentation/current-renderer.md)
in full and verify its current fact before relying on it.
